drafts.title: Permission status copy needs domain terms
checklist: The issue appears in more than one generated context or can plausibly repeat.
The proposed rule is short, testable, and points to an existing component or pattern.
Harness or preview can verify the behavior after the rule lands.
todos: Confirm rules/anti-patterns.md is still the right promotion destination.
Apply the proposed change: Add a reusable rule for page-level status copy mapping when the same Badge variants serve different business domains.
Keep public imports on the @radesign/kit barrel contract.
Run npm run validate:feedback and npm run validate after applying the patch.
Keep the rule short enough for agents to apply during generation.
acceptance: Permission status copy uses Active, Review, and Risk.
Badge variants still follow semantic severity.
Future generated pages can keep copy mapping outside kit components.
drafts.patchDraft:
diff --git a/rules/anti-patterns.md b/rules/anti-patterns.md
@@ status copy mapping
+ Add a status-copy mapping rule: keep Badge variants semantic while page or generation layers provide domain labels.
diff --git a/recipes/badge-variants.md b/recipes/badge-variants.md
@@ domain copy
+ Add permission status copy mapping: active -> Active, review -> Review, risk -> Risk.
+ Add inventory status copy mapping separately so generated pages do not reuse the wrong domain copy.

drafts.title: DataGrid needs first-class pagination display
checklist: Existing props cannot solve the issue cleanly.
The change preserves the public barrel import contract.
At least one example or harness scenario covers the new capability.
todos: Confirm components.manifest.json is still the right promotion destination.
Apply the proposed change: Add a lightweight Pagination component or DataGrid pagination recipe before promoting generated list pages to examples.
Keep public imports on the @radesign/kit barrel contract.
Run npm run validate:feedback and npm run validate after applying the patch.
Decide whether the capability belongs in component API, recipe guidance, or both.
Update examples, DOM checks, or harness coverage so the promoted capability has executable evidence.
acceptance: List page generation can show paging intent through a kit-owned API.
Harness can check paged list scenarios without custom UI classes.
drafts.patchDraft:
diff --git a/components.manifest.json b/components.manifest.json
@@ DataGrid
+ Add a reviewed pagination guidance note or helper entry tied to DataGrid.
+ Keep optionalProps aligned with the public DataGrid API.
diff --git a/examples/list-page.tsx b/examples/list-page.tsx
@@ DataGrid usage
+ Pass kit-owned pagination UI through the DataGrid pagination slot once the helper is approved.
diff --git a/harness/scenarios/generated-sample-project.json b/harness/scenarios/generated-sample-project.json
@@ checks
+ Add a pagination-intent check for operational list pages.
